note: Units of local currency per 1 USD. Balance-sheet values are converted at the rate for their own period-end date; income-statement values (FY2025) at the FY2025 average for KWD and at the peg for pegged currencies. Pegged currencies use the official peg for every date.

AED.source: Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE) — USD peg of AED 3.6725

SAR.source: Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) — USD peg of SAR 3.75

QAR.source: Qatar Central Bank — USD peg of QAR 3.64

BHD.source: Central Bank of Bahrain — USD peg of BHD 0.376

OMR.source: Central Bank of Oman — USD peg of OMR 0.3845

KWD.basis: Kuwaiti dinar is pegged to an undisclosed basket; CBK publishes a daily KWD/USD rate in fils per USD. Converted: KWD per USD = fils / 1000.
KWD.source: Central Bank of Kuwait — Currency: US Dollar daily rates (date-range table), retrieved 2026-10-12

FY2025.source: CBK Exchange Rate Policy page — annual average 2025: 306.4 fils per USD

H1 2026.source: Computed: simple average of 117 CBK daily USD rates, 4 Jan–30 Jun 2026 (306.30 fils)
